app.name: Plug'n'Heal
ui.readonly.banner: Looking only: without your permission I will not repair anything.
ui.welcome.title: Hello! I will help you with your computer.
ui.welcome.text: I look for the problem and fix it if I can. I do not need the internet for this. Before I change anything important, I will ask you.
ui.about.title: What is Plug'n'Heal?
ui.about.text:
Plug'n'Heal is a helper that lives on this drive. It works only on your computer and sends nothing to the internet.

How it works: you tell me what does not work. I take a look and try tested fixes. Before every change I make a backup, so it can be undone. Before important changes I ask you.

Everything I do is written into a report on the drive.
ui.prepare.title: One moment please, I am getting ready.
ui.prepare.hint: This usually takes 1 to 2 minutes. You do not need to do anything.
step.hardware: I am looking at your computer
step.hardware.detail: I check how much memory and which graphics card your computer has.
step.model: I am choosing the right helper
step.model.detail: I pick the helper that runs best on this computer.
step.start.detail: I am loading the helper into memory. This can take a while.
step.diagnose.detail: I check the internet, the free space and the settings. I do not change anything while doing this.
step.repair.detail: I try tested fixes, one after the other.
step.verify: I am checking whether it works now
step.verify.detail: I test whether the problem is really gone.
step.report.detail: I write down what I found and what I did.
model.reason.gpu: Your computer has a suitable graphics card. That makes me fast.
model.reason.cpu: I am working without a graphics card. That works too, just a bit slower.
model.reason.preferred: I am using the helper that was specifically requested.
model.reason.weak_hardware: Your computer is rather weak. I am using the smallest helper.
model.reason.none_installed: There is no helper stored on the drive.
ui.category.title: What is not working?
ui.category.text: Click on what fits best. If you are not sure, choose “I don't know”.
cat.all: I don't know – please check everything
ui.other.title: What is not working?
ui.other.text: Describe it in your own words. One sentence is enough.
ui.other.example: For example: “The screen is very dark.”
ui.other.empty: Please write a few words into the box first.
ui.work.title: I am taking care of it: {0}
ui.work.hint: This can take a few minutes. You do not need to do anything. If I need to ask you something, a window will open.
ui.work.cancelling: I will stop as soon as the current step is finished. One moment please …
ui.cancel.title: Do you want to stop?
ui.cancel.text: What is already done stays done. I will finish the current step and then stop.
event.thinking: I am thinking about what could help …
event.action_readonly: Not done, because I have no permission to repair: {0}
event.action_reboot: Done, but it only works after a restart: {0}
event.done.unsolved: Finished. Unfortunately the problem is not completely fixed yet.
confirm.heading: May I do this?
confirm.risk.low: The risk is small. I make a backup first, so it can be undone.
confirm.risk.medium: The risk is medium. I make a backup first. Still, something may behave differently than you are used to.
confirm.risk.high: The risk is higher. Only say “Yes” if you agree. If in doubt, ask someone who knows computers.
confirm.risk.unknown: I cannot judge the risk well. If in doubt, please say “No”.
confirm.reboot: Afterwards the computer has to restart. Please save everything that is open first.
result.solved.title: Done! The problem is fixed.
result.solved.text: I checked it: it works again now.
result.unsolved.title: Sorry, I could not completely fix the problem.
result.unsolved.text: That is not bad. Show the report to someone who knows computers. It says what I found and what I tried.
result.cancelled.title: You stopped.
result.cancelled.text: That is fine. What was already done stays as it is. The report says what I did.
result.readonly.text: Without your permission I could only look. If you want me to repair: start Plug'n'Heal again and click “Yes” when Windows asks.
result.reboot: Please restart the computer so that everything takes effect.
result.actions.title: What I did:
result.actions.none: I did not need to change anything.
result.report_path: You will find the detailed report on the drive in this folder: {0}
result.report_missing: Sorry, I cannot find the report.
result.stopped.isolated: The IT department of your company has disconnected this computer from the network. This is a safety measure, I will not change it. Please call the IT department of your company.
result.stopped.max_rounds: I have tried everything I can do safely.
result.stopped.errors: Several steps did not work, so I stopped.
report.title: Plug'n'Heal – report
report.readonly: Plug'n'Heal had no permission to repair and only looked.
report.reboot: The computer has to be restarted so that everything takes effect.
error.language_mode.title: The helper is not allowed to run here
error.language_mode.text: Helper programs like Plug'n'Heal are blocked on this computer. This is often the case on computers from a company or a school. Please ask the person who looks after this computer.
error.uac_refused.title: Without your permission I can only look
error.uac_refused.text:
You chose “No” when Windows asked. That is fine.

I can still examine the computer and tell you what I find. But I can only repair things with your permission.

If you want me to repair later: start Plug'n'Heal again and click “Yes” when Windows asks.
error.elevation_failed.title: I did not get permission to repair
error.elevation_failed.text:
Windows did not give me permission to repair. Maybe this computer has no user with administrator rights.

I can still look and tell you what I find. But I cannot repair anything this way.
error.not_admin.title: I am only allowed to look
error.not_admin.text:
I am running without administrator rights. I can examine the computer and tell you what I find, but I cannot repair anything.

If you want me to repair: start Plug'n'Heal again and click “Yes” when Windows asks.
error.smode.title: This computer is in S mode
error.smode.text:
In S mode Windows only allows apps from the Microsoft Store. That is why Plug'n'Heal cannot run here.

You can leave S mode in the settings, but this cannot be undone. If in doubt, ask someone who knows computers.
error.ollama_start.title: The helper could not be started
error.ollama_start.text:
A part of Plug'n'Heal did not start. Sometimes it helps to plug the drive into another USB port and try again.

If it still does not work, show the report to someone who knows computers.
error.no_model.title: The helper is missing on the drive
error.no_model.text: There is no language model stored on this drive. Without a language model I cannot work. The drive has to be set up again.
error.model_too_slow.title: Sorry, this computer is too slow
error.model_too_slow.text:
The helper would work so slowly on this computer that it makes no sense.

Try it on a computer with more memory, or ask someone who knows computers.
error.computer_too_weak.title: This computer does not have enough memory
error.computer_too_weak.text:
This computer does not have enough memory for the helper on this drive.

Try it on another computer, or ask someone who knows computers.
error.damaged.title: Plug'n'Heal is incomplete
error.damaged.text: Files are missing on the drive, or they are damaged. The drive has to be set up again.
error.already_running.title: Plug'n'Heal is already open
error.already_running.text: Plug'n'Heal is already running. You will find its window in the taskbar at the bottom of the screen.
error.unexpected.title: Something unexpected happened
error.unexpected.text: I am sorry, I cannot continue here. The details are in the report. Show it to someone who knows computers.
error.ui_start.title: The window could not be opened
error.ui_start.text: Plug'n'Heal could not open its window. Restart the computer and try again. If it still does not work, ask someone who knows computers.
error.console.close: Press Enter to close this window.
demo.message: The connection to the router works, but internet addresses cannot be found.
demo.action1.title: Clear the memory of internet addresses
demo.action2.title: Restart the network connection
demo.action2.explain: I switch the network connection off and on again. The internet will be gone for about 10 seconds.
demo.summary: Web pages did not open because Windows had remembered wrong addresses. I cleared this memory. Now the pages open again.
agent.step.isolation: Checking whether the computer was cut off from the network on purpose
agent.confirm.command.title: May I run this command?
agent.summary.nothingfound: The automatic check finds no fault in this area.
agent.summary.stop: I did not change anything because: {0}
agent.summary.item.rolledback: - {0}: did not work, I undid it.
agent.summary.item.declined: - {0}: not done, because you said no.
